note: Owner-voice sentence per (code, reason[, source]); `text` is the Step wording, `attendedText` the wording for a session you open yourself (sandbox spec §8). The `command` is the copyable second line. `deskSuffix` is added to every 014 and 017 `text` of a deskCapable Step. `state` marks a card shown gray or as a wait, never red.
deskSuffix: Or do it at your desk.

entries.text: This machine has no sandbox tool, so this Step can't run by itself. Install bubblewrap (`sudo apt install bubblewrap`), then press Check again.
entries.attendedText: This machine has no sandbox tool, so this session can't be opened. Install bubblewrap (`sudo apt install bubblewrap`), then press Check again.

entries.text: The system blocks the sandbox tool. Allow bubblewrap in AppArmor, then press Check again.
entries.attendedText: The system blocks the sandbox tool. Allow bubblewrap in AppArmor, then press Check again.
entries.command:
printf 'abi <abi/4.0>,
include <tunables/global>
profile bwrap /usr/bin/bwrap flags=(unconfined) {
  userns,
  include if exists <local/bwrap>
}
' | sudo tee /etc/apparmor.d/bwrap && sudo apparmor_parser -r /etc/apparmor.d/bwrap
